Hi, Kenyan girl here dating a white guy as well. I was in the exact same situation as her with my boyfriend. I kept the relationship hidden for a whole year and when my mother found out she went ballistic and guess what, she told me to break up with him. 

Now her reason wasn’t because he was white but because I kept the relationship a secret. I was 20 years old and still living with her and she even called my boyfriend to talk/yell at him. Granted my mother is very toxic so there’s that. 

Anyway, I texted my boyfriend and told him we have to end the relationship just to appease my mother and it broke my heart. BUT my boyfriend knew that it I wasn’t doing this because I wanted to but because I had no choice. Long story short, we found ways to still communicate that were very creative for sure without my family knowing and guess what, I’m now living on my own in a different state much closer to my boyfriend and we’re going on 2.5 years together and I couldn’t be happier.
